pairs.registryProposal: The Rust application for this technique cites margin.rs glyph() as the worked example and does not mention table padding. The technique now requires display-width padding; md.rs still documents chars().count() and a one-column drift on wide glyphs, so the application and the decision rule disagree about this repo.
